summary.request: Sales orders carry a Project Code. It must appear in the PEPPOL invoice we send through E-Documents, and when a supplier sends us an e-invoice containing a project code, that code must land on the purchase invoice created from the e-document.
summary.business-process: Sales order posting with outgoing PEPPOL e-invoicing through E-Document Core, and incoming e-invoice import (V2) into purchase invoices.

objects.purpose: New reader value whose Implementation binds IStructuredFormatReader to the custom reader codeunit; the built-in PEPPOL reader is internal and raises no event.

Reads the incoming e-invoice blob into E-Document Purchase Header and E-Document Purchase Line (InsertForEDocument), including the Project Code staging field, and returns the Purchase Invoice draft type. It must also parse the standard fields the built-in reader would fill (see unresolved).
Holds the export subscriber (adds Project Code to the PEPPOL XML) and the import subscriber (copies the staging value to the created Purchase Header).
Show Project Code for entry on the sales order and read-only on the posted invoice. Other pages per q-pages.

data-flow.note: Entered on the sales order (page extension).
Sales-Post TransferFields(SalesHeader); same field number and type required, no subscriber.

data-flow.to: Sales Shipment Header / Sales Cr.Memo Header / Return Receipt Header .Project Code

data-flow.note: E-Doc. Mapping.MapRecord uses RecordRef.Copy, so the table extension field is carried; E-Document created by Core after the posting commit.

data-flow.to: PEPPOL BIS 3.0 XML in Temp Blob
data-flow.note: OnAfterCreatePEPPOLXMLDocument subscriber loads the XML from the blob, adds the element and writes it back to the same blob. UBL element per q-ubl-element.
Custom IStructuredFormatReader bound to the new E-Doc. Read into Draft value (V2 import process).
OnAfterProcessIncomingEDocument with DesiredEndState = Processed; header found by E-Document Link = EDocument.SystemId; value set with Validate and Modify(true).

data-flow.to: Purch. Inv. Header / Purch. Rcpt. Header / Purch. Cr. Memo Hdr. / Return Shipment Header .Project Code
data-flow.note: Purch.-Post TransferFields(PurchHeader); article-chosen stages, see q-purchase-mirror-targets.

subscriptions.purpose: Add the Project Code element to the finished PEPPOL XML for an outgoing sales invoice.
guards: Exit unless SourceDocumentHeader.Number() = Database::"Sales Invoice Header" (other document types per q-credit-memo-peppol).
Read the value from the SourceDocumentHeader record ref (SetTable), never re-read the posted invoice by number, so the service mapping rules apply.
Exit when Project Code is empty.
Load the XML from the passed Temp Blob and write the result back to the same blob.
No blocking errors here: Create runs after the posting commit; posting-blocking rules belong in the format Check (q-require-on-posting).

subscriptions.purpose: Copy the staged Project Code to the purchase invoice created by the V2 finish step, which copies only named staging fields and raises no event.
guards: Find Purchase Header by "E-Document Link" = EDocument.SystemId; exit if none is linked.
Exit when the staging Project Code is empty.
Do not use the V1 E-Document Create Purch. Doc. events; they never fire for a Version 2.0 service.

lifecycle.step: E-Document Service: keep Import Process = Version 2.0 and configure the service to read incoming documents with the new E-Doc. Read into Draft value (exact configuration step unresolved).

Outgoing: the bill-to customer document sending profile must use Electronic Document = Extended E-Document Service Flow with an enabled workflow that uses the PEPPOL BIS 3.0 service, and the service must support the outgoing sales invoice type; otherwise no E-Document is created and no error is raised.
Set DataClassification = CustomerContent (or the classification the requester confirms) on every Project Code field, including the staging field; no ToBeClassified ships.
Ship a permission set covering the new codeunits.

tests.given: A customer and item created with LibrarySales/LibraryInventory and a sales order with Project Code set
tests.when: The order is shipped and invoiced
tests.then: Sales Invoice Header and Sales Shipment Header hold the same Project Code

tests.given: A sales credit memo and a sales return order with Project Code set
tests.then: Sales Cr.Memo Header and Return Receipt Header hold the Project Code

tests.given: A sales order with Project Code
tests.then: Sales Header Archive holds the Project Code

tests.given: PEPPOL BIS 3.0 service with supported outgoing sales invoice type, enabled workflow and a customer document sending profile set to Extended E-Document Service Flow; sales order with Project Code
tests.when: The order is posted and the E-Document is exported
tests.then: The exported PEPPOL XML in the E-Document log contains the Project Code element with the value

tests.given: Same e-document setup; sales order without Project Code
tests.when: The order is posted and exported
tests.then: The XML contains no Project Code element and the E-Document is not in Export Error

tests.given: Same e-document setup; a posted sales credit memo
tests.when: The credit memo E-Document is exported
tests.then: The subscriber exits on the table-number guard and the XML is unchanged

tests.given: An E-Document Service with Import Process Version 2.0 using the custom reader; an incoming e-invoice containing a project code
tests.when: The E-Document is processed to Processed
tests.then: The Purchase Header linked by E-Document Link holds the Project Code
E-Document Purchase Header holds the Project Code and no Purchase Header is changed

tests.given: Same service; an incoming e-invoice without a project code
tests.when: The E-Document is processed to Processed
tests.then: The purchase invoice is created and its Project Code is empty with no error

tests.given: A purchase invoice with Project Code (created by import or LibraryPurchase)
tests.then: Purch. Inv. Header holds the Project Code

tests.given: A purchase document with Project Code
tests.then: Purchase Header Archive holds the Project Code

knowledge.used-for: Export through the PEPPOL event and V2 import through a custom reader plus the after-processing subscriber.
constraints: Value must already be on the posted table (Sales Invoice Header) for export.
For PEPPOL subscribe to OnAfterCreatePEPPOLXMLDocument; read the field from the record ref, load the XML from the blob, add the element and write it back to the same blob.
Do not re-read the posted invoice by number in the PEPPOL subscriber; that bypasses the service mapping rules.
Add the field to E-Document Purchase Header and Purchase Header; fill the staging field in an own IStructuredFormatReader bound to a new E-Doc. Read into Draft value.
Subscribe to OnAfterProcessIncomingEDocument; act only when DesiredEndState is Processed, find the purchase header by E-Document Link, exit if none is linked.
Do not use V1 purchase-creation events for a V2 service, and do not expect Core to copy a staging extension field by matching name.

knowledge.used-for: Stage map for the sales field, page extensions, permission entries, Copy Document decision and posting tests.
constraints: Decide which stages the field must reach and plan one step per stage.
Name the page extensions, the permission set entries for new objects, and a test that posts and reads the value back from every target.
Decide whether Copy Document flowing the field back from posted documents is wanted; if not, clear it in OnAfterCopySalesHeaderDone.
Do not plan to fill ledger entries by modifying them after posting.

knowledge.used-for: Where blocking checks belong and the setup needed for an E-Document to be created.
constraints: E-Document creation runs after the posting commit; errors in Create leave the invoice posted and set Export Error.
Rules that must stop posting go in the format Check.
Tests must enable the document sending profile, workflow and supported types or no E-Document is created and no error is raised.
No E-Document is created right after posting when commit is suppressed or in preview.

Create customers, vendors, items and documents with the Library codeunits; create parents first and Validate foreign keys.
User-facing page fields need an explicit or inherited tooltip; on runtime 13.0+ define it on the table field and do not duplicate it on pages (applies from BC24 for inheritance).

open-questions.question: What is "Project Code" on the sales order today: an existing field (which table extension, field number, type and length, table relation), a new field to add, a dimension (shortcut dimension) or the Job No.? The design assumes a custom Code[20] header field; a dimension or Job No. would change objects and data flow.
Which object ID and field number range does the app own? The same field number must be used on every TransferFields target.
Must Project Code also reach Sales Shipment Header, Sales Cr.Memo Header, Return Receipt Header and Sales Header Archive? The article includes them unless a document type never needs it.
Must Project Code reach the posted purchase invoice and the other posted purchase tables and archive, or only the unposted purchase invoice the request names?
Must Project Code reach Cust. Ledger Entry, Vendor Ledger Entry or G/L Entry? Not designed.
Is Project Code a header-only value, or can lines carry different project codes (in the PEPPOL export and on import)?

Which UBL element carries the project code in the outgoing invoice and is read from incoming invoices (for example a project reference or accounting cost element), and at which position in the document?
Should PEPPOL credit memos also carry the project code? The design adds it to sales invoices only.

Must posting or release be blocked when Project Code is empty for customers that receive e-invoices? That rule would belong in a format Check, which the built-in PEPPOL format does not offer to extend.
What should happen when an incoming project code does not exist in BC or fails validation on Purchase Header: error, store as is, or skip?
Is it acceptable to replace the built-in PEPPOL reader with an own reader that must also parse all standard invoice data, given the built-in reader is internal and raises no event?
Should Copy Document carry Project Code back from posted or archived documents into new sales or purchase documents?
On which pages should Project Code be visible besides Sales Order, Posted Sales Invoice, Purchase Invoice and Posted Purchase Invoice (lists, other posted documents, E-Document draft page)?
